self-harm · medical · legal ·
financial-risk · minors · abuse

Normal reflective guidance
never deterministic predictions on
health, death, divorce, jobs
+ fear-selling lint per locale

L2 · Constrained mode:
astrology framing REMOVED
empathetic + factual only
avatar state 11
